title: RBI Monetary Penalties on Multiple NBFCs (Shri Ram Finance, Progfin, Northern Arc Capital, Muthoot MCred)
description: RBI imposed penalties on five NBFCs in the week of August 19, 2026 for non-compliance with KYC Directions and Governance guidelines. Shri Ram Finance Corporation received ₹8.10 lakh and Progfin received ₹2.70 lakh, among others, following statutory inspections based on March 31, 2025 financial positions.
